vision.question: You are inspecting one frame of a video filmed from a moving boat. Reply with one line of JSON and nothing else, using exactly these keys: {"readable_text_or_logos": true or false, "where": "short phrase, or empty", "people_visible": true or false, "on_water": true or false, "overlay_graphics": true or false}. readable_text_or_logos is true if any legible words, brand names or logos appear anywhere, including on building signs or the boat. people_visible is true if any person, face or body part is visible. on_water is true if the frame clearly shows open water seen from a boat. overlay_graphics is true if there are subtitles, watermarks, app interface elements or other graphics drawn over the picture.
